mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.1 percentage points in a single month) signals an imminent monetary tightening, causing short-term equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.1pp in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and a contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a strong labor market (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% month-over-month) signals a potential economic recovery, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high unemployment with strong labor market growth
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 1-year moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST falling below 900 thousand units) signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 900.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 230) signals aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is rising and CPIAUCSL > 230.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annualized), a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 900) signals an imminent slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST < 900.
